```{r}
library(sta310r)
```

## Overview

`sta310r` contains the 33 data sets that accompany Collett (2023), *Modelling
Survival Data in Medical Research* (4th edition), documented for the STA310
course at the University of Gothenburg. Each data set has a help page with the
background of the study, the coded variables and references to the relevant
chapter and examples in Collett (2023).

## The data sets

All data sets are available by name once the package is loaded:

```{r}
data(package = "sta310r")$results[, "Item"]
```

The data sets used most often in the lectures are `iud`, `breast`, `myeloma`,
`ovarian`, `liver` and `rats`. As an example, `iud` holds the time to
discontinuation of the use of an IUD for 18 women:

```{r}
iud
```

The package also includes [scottish_mbc_cohort], a synthetic cohort used in the
computer exercises.

## Data sets by example

Every data set that is used in a worked example of Collett (2023) has an alias
`dX.Y`, where `X.Y` is the number of the example. See
`vignette("datasets-by-exercise")` for the full index.

## Computer exercises

The course exercises are vignettes in the package:

- `vignette("cs1-survival-data")` — the questions for Computer exercise 1
  (Chapters 1–2).
- `vignette("cs1-solutions")` — the same document with the solutions included
  after each question.

The exercises use the data sets in this package together with the `survival`
package. They do not rely on any estimator functions from `sta310r`; the
analysis code is written with the standard `survival` workflow.
